notes.text: The exact Yerushalmi gives Mani ruling for Rabbi La of Kefara about tearing, mourning and impurity at collection of bones.
Mana rules for Hillel of Kifra in the bone-gathering case.
This parallel again names Mana and Hillel of Kifra. The Sanhedrin account gives Mani and La of Kefara.
The Mani article independently repeats the Hillel of Kefari wording within Heilprin’s edition.

The final pointer needs edition-specific location. The mourning episode has exact parallels in Pesachim, Moed Katan and Sanhedrin. The checked Bava Kamma opening did not give the exact episode or person.
